name: onelitefeather-claude-marketplace
description: OneLiteFeather — Claude Code plugins for our developer framework (Outline knowledge graph + standardized dev tooling)

plugins.name: framework
plugins.description: OneLiteFeather's developer framework: bundles standardized tools for how the team builds software, including a knowledge graph in Outline's "Vault" collection and git hygiene for commit and PR messages.

plugins.name: framework-code-navigation
plugins.description: Optional companion to framework: Serena (LSP symbol search) for JVM/Java-Kotlin projects. Install only where it fits.

plugins.name: minestom-knowledge
plugins.description: Accurate knowledge of OneLiteFeather's internal Minestom libraries and tooling (Cyano testing, Gradle conventions, BOM hierarchy, Guira setup flows, Aves utilities, Xerus minigame core, Pica dialogs, Coris floors/rooms/doors), too internal/new to be in general training data.

plugins.name: release-engineering
plugins.description: OneLiteFeather's CI/CD standard: Release Please, the central Renovate preset plus general Renovate config help, and the reusable GitHub Actions workflows (build, publish, Docker, Gradle specifics).

plugins.name: agent-orchestrator
plugins.description: Decomposes complex tasks into independent subtasks and delegates each to the cheapest viable model tier (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable — fable gated behind explicit confirmation), escalating only when a subtask proves too hard. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: requirement-engineering
plugins.description: OneLiteFeather's Requirement-Engineering standard for Outline project docs: User Stories + EARS acceptance-criteria syntax + MoSCoW prioritization, for game concepts and technical projects alike. Creates new requirements docs and restructures superficial prose-only concept docs.

plugins.name: micronaut-standards
plugins.description: OneLiteFeather's standard for Micronaut REST APIs: dependency management, observability, service layer, entity design, configuration, DTO/response modeling, OpenAPI docs, HTTP routing, exception handling, security baseline, Liquibase migrations, Testcontainers, and logging.

plugins.name: git-hygiene
plugins.description: Keeps commit messages, branch names, PR titles and bodies, issue comments and release notes free of AI tool branding, session URLs, machine typography and machine phrasing. Ships the attribution settings, a PreToolUse safety net, and an optional commit-msg hook.
